verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox or test environment that is isolated from production data. Self-hosting is only a user-side workaround that could stand up a separate instance, and the code-execution docs never say the code runs in an isolated sandbox. Neither counts as a product-provided test environment, and no dry-run mode is documented either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
